name: Taira Misaki
source:
[b]S-Class Doting Damsel[/b]

Occupation: Kindergarten Teacher
Height: Average
Breast Size: Large

According to the [url=/c112365]inn manager[/url], resident Misaki is deemed the "S-Class Indulger" - her own words. 

This warm-natured beauty was practically made to nurture children. While her daily routine was fulfilling, Misaki harbored a secret longing - to pamper not a child but a romantic partner. Upon meeting [url=/c112508]the protagonist[/url] for the first time, she immediately thought, "I want to dote on this one rotten."

「Don't be shy ♥ It makes me happy when you get all needy and spoiled around me ♥」
